title: Hamilton Street Railway Adds Capacity with New High Tech Bus Facility
summary: This past week marked the opening of a new bus maintenance and storage facility in Hamilton, with the inauguration of the new Birch Transit Centre occurring on June 23 in the city’s North End industrial zone. Attended by Minister of Transportation Prabmeet Sarkaria and Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath, the event celebrated a nearly $400 million investment in Hamilton’s transit network.

title: 88 Isabella Resubmitted as 50-Storey Purpose-Built Rental Tower
summary: Capital Developments has submitted a significantly revised proposal for 88 Isabella Street in Toronto’s Church-Wellesley neighbourhood, replacing the previously approved 62-storey condominium tower with a 50-storey purpose-built rental building. Designed by Diamond Schmitt Architects, the resubmitted proposal retains the rental replacement housing component on the site.
